name: [Twinblade!] Mech Showdown (Alpha)
desc:
NEW MECH TETSU ONI ALONG WITH SEASON 4 IS NOW LIVE! 

EMOTE! - Be sure to get your taunt emote by liking the game and joining our group!

Ever wanted to be a mech warrior? Well now you can! Sophisticated mech warfare. Each mech is custom built to transform into various shapes and weapons. 

Playable on all platforms 🎮📱💻

Game Controls 💻 (PC) 
Dash - Q 
Evade - Q while down 
Mouse Left-Click - punch  / normal attack 
F - Block 
Space - Jump
Skills - 1/2/3/4
Ultimate - G 
Emote - B

Have fun!
